ios.desc:
Use your detective skills to spot differences between two seemingly identical pictures. With more than 60 levels and hundreds of differences, 5 Differences brings hours of game play to your iOS devices. When playing on your iPhone or iPad, high resolution and pannable and zoomable levels make for an enjoyable experience. Dynamically created levels mean that each play-through is unique, so you can always go back and play again. Increase your focus and ability to pay attention to details by playing 5 Differences! Download Now!

Please Note: This is a premium game being offered for free. Although there are in-app purchases to quickly unlock more advanced levels, it is possible to reach these levels for free by beating previous levels. You do not need to pay to play or win; all levels are unlockable. 

Casual and comfortable game, prefect for relaxing and meditating. 

Features:

-More than 50 exciting levels with hundreds of differences
-High resolution levels with easy panning for an enjoyable experience on smaller iPhone devices.
-Dynamic differences so each play-through is a unique experience

Support:

If you’re having questions, concerns, or suggestions, you can contact us at info@frontrowsoft.com
